```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE
)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)

data("ny_noaa", package = "p8105.datasets")

weather_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  filter(
    id == "USC00300055",
    date >= as.Date("2010-01-01"),
    date < as.Date("2011-01-01")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,
    month = factor(
      as.integer(format(date, "%m")),
      levels = 1:12,
      labels = month.abb
    )
  ) |>
  select(id, date, month, tmax, tmin) |>
  arrange(date)

weather_check =
  weather_df |>
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_dates = n_distinct(date),
    missing_tmax = sum(is.na(tmax)),
    missing_tmin = sum(is.na(tmin)),
    reversed_temperatures = sum(tmin > tmax, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

stopifnot(
  weather_check$n_observations == 365,
  weather_check$n_dates == 365,
  weather_check$missing_tmax == 0,
  weather_check$missing_tmin == 0,
  weather_check$reversed_temperatures == 0
)

monthly_summary =
  weather_df |>
  group_by(month) |>
  summarise(
    mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_tmin = mean(tmin, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_df =
  monthly_summary |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("mean_"),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "temperature"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measure = recode(
      measure,
      mean_tmax = "Daily maximum",
      mean_tmin = "Daily minimum"
    ),
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Month: ", month,
      "<br>Measure: ", measure,
      "<br>Monthly mean: ", round(temperature, 1), " °C"
    )
  )

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)
```

Row {data-height=450}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Monthly mean temperatures

```{r monthly-line}
monthly_plot =
  ggplot(
    monthly_df,
    aes(
      x = month,
      y = temperature,
      color = measure,
      group = measure,
      text = hover_text
    )
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Daily maximum" = "#D55E00", "Daily minimum" = "#0072B2")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Month (2010)",
    y = "Monthly mean temperature (°C)",
    color = NULL
  )

ggplotly(monthly_plot, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    margin = list(l = 75, r = 25, b = 95, t = 20),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.5, xanchor = "center", y = -0.2)
  ) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

Row {data-height=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily minimum and maximum

```{r daily-scatter}
scatter_df =
  weather_df |>
  mutate(
    hover_text = paste0(
      "Date: ", date,
      "<br>Minimum: ", tmin, " °C",
      "<br>Maximum: ", tmax, " °C"
    )
  )

scatter_plot =
  ggplot(scatter_df, aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, text = hover_text)) +
  geom_point(color = "#0072B2", alpha = 0.65, size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Daily minimum temperature (°C)",
    y = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)"
  )

ggplotly(scatter_plot, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(margin = list(l = 75, r = 25, b = 75, t = 20)) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

Row {data-height=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Daily maxima by month

```{r monthly-box}
box_plot =
  ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = month, y = tmax)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#56B4E9", alpha = 0.7, width = 0.65) +
  labs(
    x = "Month (2010)",
    y = "Daily maximum temperature (°C)"
  )

ggplotly(box_plot) |>
  layout(margin = list(l = 75, r = 25, b = 75, t = 20)) |>
  config(displaylogo = FALSE)
```

### Notes and sources

<div class="dashboard-notes">

Data: [`p8105.datasets::ny_noaa`](https://p8105.com/dataset_noaa.html); station **USC00300055**.

I selected January 1–December 31, 2010, for this station
and converted the temperature fields from character values in tenths of a degree
to numeric values in °C. No days were removed or sampled after selection.
There are **`r weather_check$n_observations` observations** on
**`r weather_check$n_dates` distinct dates**, with
**`r weather_check$missing_tmax` missing maxima**,
**`r weather_check$missing_tmin` missing minima**, and
**`r weather_check$reversed_temperatures` records where the minimum exceeds the maximum**.

The line chart averages daily minima and maxima within
each month, giving each day equal weight. Each scatterplot point represents one
day. The boxplots show the median, middle 50%, and spread of daily maxima within
each month, rather than monthly averages.

</div>
